newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Arago to boost its stake in Pannon-Valto.
newsitem.headline: Arago to boost its stake in Pannon-Valto.

text.p: Arago Befektetesi Holding Rt, currently minority owner of Hungarian investment holding Pannon-Valto Rt, has made a public bid for Pannon-Valto shares to boost its stake to 51 percent, Pannon-Valto said on Tuesday.
Arago, formerly HB Westminster II Rt, now holds around 33 percent of Pannon-Valto's 1.75 billion forint share capital, Pannon-Valto's General Director Gyula Scheuer told Reuters.
"They would like to acquire (a total of) 51 percent at 62 percent (of the face value)," Scheuer said.
The bid at 62 percent of the 1,000 forint face value means a price of 620 forints/share. The bid is open until September 27.
Today on the Budapest Stock Exchange Pannon-Valto shares closed at 615 forints, up 15.
Scheuer said Arago did not have intentions to delist Pannon-Valto from the Budapest bourse.
